notes:
What's new in 0.1.142:
- Live TV on this PC: when a channel stops sending, the player now says the channel stopped and shows Try again, like the phone app. Before, the picture froze on its last frame with Play and LIVE and no message.
- Playing a film from a library that another home shared with you is still being built. Parts of it are inside this version but switched off, so nothing about sharing changes yet.
- Windows only. The phone app and Beebo Auto are separate releases.
- Automated checks: the full Windows desktop test suite was run on the release source (2,184 test files, 22,356 tests): 22,210 passed and 0 failed (one test failed once and passed when run again); 109 tests in 34 files were skipped, so they were not run (mostly checks that need Linux, file links, an optional browser package or an opt-in switch), and 37 are marked as future work. The signed installer passed its signature, size, converter, connection-helper and language checks. No person has installed 0.1.142 yet, so its changes and its in-app update from 0.1.141 have not been tried by a person.
- Release source commit d808d9ae2.
- Built: Nov 24, 2026, 2:24 AM Eastern.
- Published: Jan 1, 2099, 12:00 AM Eastern.
